svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Blank 160 x 250 mm, 3 mm aluminium. Front view is the face the arm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: butts against. Heights from the bottom edge; sideways from the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Band slots 3 x 15 mm at 66 mm each side, centred 15 and 235 mm up:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: chain drill 3 mm and file square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bracket bolts 6.6 mm at 10 mm each side, 83 and 167 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: V-saddle screws 4.5 mm on the centre line, 40, 60, 190 and 210 mm up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr every hole; round the corners to about 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: V-saddles on the back; the arm tube butts the front at mid

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: height, held by the two brackets; the bands cross the front above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: offer the brackets up and look through the bolt holes.
